subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: May this PR retire the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow without an equivalent post-publish repair path, or must it preserve or replace that recovery path first?
rationale: The code evidence shows the remaining npm publish workflow cannot repair the exact post-publish failure mode documented for the deleted workflow, so this is an operational release-automation tradeoff rather than a routine cleanup.

options.title: Replace Or Keep The Repair Path
options.body: Require this PR to preserve the standalone workflow or add an equivalent release-only repair mode that works after npm has accepted the package.

options.title: Retire With Owner Acceptance
options.body: Accept the loss of the standalone recovery path only if release/security automation owners document the manual recovery procedure and update the tests accordingly.

options.title: Close This Cleanup PR
options.body: Close the PR if the repair workflow remains the intended supported recovery path and no replacement is planned.

recommendation.title: Replace Or Keep The Repair Path
recommendation.body: Require this PR to preserve the standalone workflow or add an equivalent release-only repair mode that works after npm has accepted the package.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the CODEOWNERS route for workflows and deploy specs touched by the PR.
